messages:
kate_devops: Hey — does anyone know where the Asia‑Pacific service overview + model‑health panel lives? Trying to triage a customer report for singap.re region tail latency, but Grafana shows 403 for me.
sam_engineer: likely org perms. There's a shortlink in the infra dashboard list but only eng-platform + eng-sre can view. @jia_sre can confirm.
jia_sre: Yup — we tightened access on the Model Health folder last week. Two dashboards: `Service Overview` (per-region service metrics) and `Model Health (by model)`.

jia_sre: Shortlinks:
- Service Overview: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/service-overview?orgId=1
- Model Health: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/zzxy9876/model-health?orgId=1

(you won't be able to open them until perms are granted)

kate_devops: both would help, customer call in 20m. Any quick queries I can run in Loki/Tempo if you can't add me fast?
sam_engineer: For traces in Tempo:
```
service="redwood-runtime" and span.operation =~ "token.*" and duration > 200ms
```
For logs in Loki:
```
{job="runtime", region="singap.re"} |= "tail latency" | json | latency > 200
```
That should surface tail latency spans/logs quickly.

deploy-bot: Policy change: grafana/folders/Model-Health updated by nate_infra at 2025-11-03T09:12:01Z
nate_infra: Sorry about the surprise — we locked the folder to reduce accidental edits. I can temporarily add you kate_devops for 1 hour. Want me to do that now? :wrench:
kate_devops: yes please, that would be perfect, thanks!
nate_infra: done — you should have Viewer access now, try the links.
kate_devops: I can open them now, thank you!! :raised_hands: I see a p99.9 spike for model-x in singap.re around 09:02 UTC.

oliver_product: FYI, customer is on an older routing tier that hits singap.re more. If this is frequent we might need to adjust the alerting threshold for that region. @jia_sre can we consider tuning p99.9 from 300ms -> 500ms for singap.re while we investigate network causes?
jia_sre: Will open a follow-up; agree to discuss thresholds. I'll also check whether caching/batching for that model was reduced in the last deploy.

oliver_product: created issue: https://redwoodhq/issue/2342 — tagging eng-platform and infra for followup.
kate_devops: re: traces — jumping into Tempo now, will DM any interesting spans. Thanks all.
tempo-bot: New trace search completed (5 hits) — https://tempo.redwood.ai/trace/xyz
sam_engineer: If you need a quick on-call escalation, ping @eng-oncall channel. Otherwise we'll track in #2342.

kate_devops: closing here — got what I need for the call. Nate, please remove the temporary access after 1h. Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
